articles.title: Samsung Securities Data Breach Exposes 8,241 Customers’ Personal and Account Details
articles.summary:
Samsung Securities confirmed on November 23 that a data breach exposed personal information belonging to 8,241 customers. The South Korean brokerage detected unauthorized access on Saturday, November 21, in its Voice of Customer (VOC) system, a website service for complaints and inquiries. The company found no evidence of exposure outside the affected system. The breach […]

articles.title: Hackers Secretly Spy on Bulgarian Government for Five Years and Steal 62 Million Pages of Documents
articles.summary:
Bulgaria has disrupted a cyberespionage operation that gave hackers covert access to state administration networks for five years. Innovation and Digital Transformation Minister Ivan Vasilev said on November 18 that the intruders illegally downloaded at least 130 gigabytes of government documents, equivalent to more than 62 million pages. articles.title: Hackers Use 480+ Malicious Ad Domains to Target iPhones and Steal Crypto Wallet Recovery Phrases
articles.summary:
Hackers are using a large network of malicious ads to break into vulnerable iPhones and steal cryptocurrency wallet recovery phrases, passwords, messages, and photos. Researchers tracking the operation, named MoldyRoost, identified more than 480 advertising domains targeting users across over 47 countries between May 12 and November 17, 2026. articles.title: Palo Alto Confirms NGINX Vulnerabilities Impact PAN-OS and Releases Workarounds
articles.summary:
Palo Alto Networks confirmed that two critical NGINX flaws, CVE-2026-123633 and CVE-2026-123007, affect PAN-OS and Panorama deployments with HTTP/2 enabled. The flaws could allow unauthenticated remote attackers to crash worker processes or execute code, prompting Palo Alto Networks to release patches and a workaround for affected systems. The security advisory assigns a CVSS v4.0 score […]
